summary: Google DeepMind released version 2.4.0 of the Concordia generative agent-based simulation library, adding an asynchronous engine, multimodal (image) support, a visual UI, and various fixes, deprecations and refactors.

practices.reason: Teams using entity_agent.stateless_act need to migrate to act before the method is removed.
practices.quote: Add deprecation warning on entity_agent.stateless_act, use act instead.

practices.reason: A new asynchronous simulation engine changes how multi-agent workflows could be structured, but no gain or benchmark is stated, so it's worth watching rather than adopting yet.
Migration off the deprecated google.generativeai/vertexai SDKs to google.genai will require code changes for anyone using those model wrappers directly.
practices.quote: Migrated deprecated google.generativeai and vertexai package to the newer google.genai package
